document.abstract: The planned Advanced Television transmission system for the United States will be in place before many program producers can afford true High Definition equipment. The paper discusses a proposed interim production standard, and relates its capabilities to the requirements for an enhanced viewing experience in the home. The economic advantages of the interim system are discussed, and consideration is given to the role of image processing equipment in optimizing display of the images.
